capabilities: Expose iconId identifiers for use by other plugins
Auto-reload Commander so its icon picker picks up icon changes
extras: Can also be installed as a beta plugin via BRAT; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian ships a fixed set of UI icons and offers no built-in way to add custom icons or replace the defaults.
